name: Ground Flick
description: Use the hurley at ground level to dispossess or redirect the sliotar away from an opponent.

name: Overhead Strike
description: Strike a high sliotar overhead while maintaining balance, timing and awareness of nearby players.

name: Underarm Throw
description: Send an object accurately toward a target using a controlled underarm throwing action.

name: Hurley Balance
description: Carry and control a beanbag or sliotar on the bas of the hurley while stationary or moving.
